Maya (Finance): Heads up — BluHatch (SMB pilot) triggered a big usage spike during a test run. Invoice INV-2026-042 shows an unexpected overage. Can we process a goodwill/manual credit to keep them on the pilot?
Sam K. (Billing): Can you paste the invoice lines so I can check token vs embedding charges?
Maya (Finance): Copy of the invoice snippet:
```
INV-2026-042
Customer: BluHatch (SMB pilot)
Period: 2026-03-01 - 2026-03-20
Line items:
 - gen tokens: 1,220,000 @ $0.0004 = $488
 - embeddings: 3,200 @ $0.06 = $192
 - reserved capacity: $1,000
Total: $1,680
Previous credits applied: $0
Billed: $1,680
```
Maya (Finance): Platform also shows an $80 anomaly that looks like duplicated ingestion events. AE is asking for something we can apply quickly.
Sam K. (Billing): Hmm. If there were duplicate ingestion retries that drove token count up we can consider a manual adjustment. Need logs/job ids to validate.
Liam (CS): We ran a one-off test on 2026-03-19 that retried a batch at 03:12 UTC. Job id: x9f3-20260319. Logs show ~200k tokens re-sent. I attached the trace in the ticket. This looks like qualifying accidental duplication.
Elaine (Account Exec): BluHatch is on a free/low-touch pilot. They're nervous about the surprise charge. They want the overage removed but are fine paying the reserved capacity. Asking for a friendly resolution.
Sam K. (Billing): Quick math: 200k gen tokens @ $0.0004 = $80. Duplicate embeddings maybe 1600 @ $0.06 = $96. Combined duplication ~= $176. Maya reported an $80 anomaly — can you confirm which lines are duplicates vs expected?
Maya (Finance): Platform breakdown shows the extra tokens were 200k and extra embeddings ~1600. The additional $80 flagged was part of token duplication; embeddings add the rest. I'm leaning to credit the total duplicate amount $176 and add a $100 goodwill to soften impact — so $276 total.
Sam K. (Billing): If Finance ok with $276 I'll create the credit memo. Accounting needs a short reason and approver. Suggest reason: "trial duplicate ingestion + goodwill".
Maya (Finance): Agreed. Reason looks good. Pinging Nina (Head of Finance) for approval.
Sam K. (Billing): @billing-bot create-credit INV-2026-042 amount=276 reason=\"trial duplicate ingestion + goodwill\"
billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-2026-391 for $276 linked to INV-2026-042. Status: pending-approval (needs Finance approval).
Maya (Finance): Nina — can you review? This is an SMB pilot, quick win to keep them on board.
Nina (Head of Finance): Approved. Please apply the $276 credit and update the invoice record. :thumbsup:
billing-bot: Credit CM-2026-391 applied to INV-2026-042. Customer balance updated to $0. Notification sent to AE (Elaine).
Elaine (Account Exec): Thanks everyone — I'll notify BluHatch and confirm they're happy. :raised_hands:
Sam K. (Billing): Filing closure note in Tix-2894 and marking credit as applied. Leaving follow-up to AE for customer confirmation.
Maya (Finance): Thanks team — good catch from CS. Closing loop."
